html:
A guerrilla commander of the war of independence who seized power in a coup in 1980, ruled Guinea-Bissau until 1999 and again from 2005 until he was killed in 2009.

He overthrew Luis Cabral in November 1980, ruled a one-party state, then won the first multiparty election in 1994. A revolt by army chief Ansumane Mane began the civil war of 1998, and Vieira was driven out in 1999. He returned and won the 2005 election. On 2 March 2009 soldiers killed him at his home, hours after the army chief died in a bomb blast. No elected president of the country finished a full term until 2020.
sum: A guerrilla commander of the war of independence who seized power in a coup in 1980, ruled Guinea-Bissau until 1999 and again from 2005 until he was killed in 2009.
